reported_issue: SIGKILL of the supervising Bash released the only guard owner while a child that had closed inherited guard descriptors could continue running.

resolution.architecture: outer Bash lock owner -> primary Python guardian -> stopped task plus independent pidfd lease keeper
resolution.start_gate: The task remains blocked on a pipe until pidfd_open succeeds and the keeper acknowledges readiness.
resolution.single_failure_behavior: SIGKILL of the outer Bash or primary guardian alone leaves another holder until the task root exits.
resolution.status_behavior: A held guard with a dead/missing owner PID reports BUSY guardian=active and remains impossible to acquire.

coverage: existing free/busy, metadata, exit-code, admission and dual-lock tests
task closes all descriptors >=3 while lock stays busy
SIGKILL outer Bash while the no-guard-FD task remains alive
SIGKILL primary guardian while the no-guard-FD task remains alive
a blocking contender acquires only after the real task exits
no guardian process remains after the isolated test

residual_risks: Whole-host failure or simultaneous destruction of every guard holder can still leave a remote orphan.
A target that daemonizes violates the protocol; the lease follows the declared task root PID.
GamePC stale takeover still requires a remote process preflight.
